提升因果推理Lifted Causal Inference

malte.luttermann@dfki.de    \fnmTanya \surBraun tanya.braun@uni-muenster.de    \fnmRalf \surMöller ralf.moeller@uni-hamburg.de    \fnmMarcel \surGehrke marcel.gehrke@uni-hamburg.de [ * [
摘要Abstract

提升推理通过使用不可区分对象的代表来利用概率图模型中的不可区分性，从而在保持准确答案的同时加快查询回答速度。 在本文中，我们展示了如何应用提升来有效计算关系域中的因果效应。 更具体地说，我们介绍Lifted inference exploits indistinguishabilities in probabilistic graphical models by using a representative for indistinguishable objects, thereby speeding up query answering while maintaining exact answers. In this article, we show how lifting can be applied to efficiently compute causal effects in relational domains. More specifically, we introduce参数因果因素图parametric causal factor graphs将因果知识纳入提升的模型中，并给出其中干预的正式语义。 我们进一步提出to incorporate causal knowledge in lifted models and give a formal semantics of interventions therein. We further present the提升因果推理Lifted Causal Inference (生命周期指数LCI）算法在提升的水平上计算因果效应，从而与命题推理相比大大加快了因果推理的速度，例如，) algorithm to compute causal effects on a lifted level, thereby drastically speeding up causal inference compared to propositional inference, e.g., in因果贝叶斯网络causal Bayesian networks。 此外，我们还提出. In addition, we present部分有向参数因果因子图partially directed parametric causal factor graphs作为一般化as a generalisation ofPCFGPCFGs处理部分因果知识并扩展to handle partial causal knowledge and extend生命周期指数LCI执行提升因果推理to perform lifted causal inference in aPD-PCFG，从而将提升因果推理的适用性扩展到更广泛的模型，需要较少的因果关系先验知识。, thereby extending the applicability of lifted causal inference to a broader range of models requiring less prior knowledge about causal relationships.

因果推理、提升、概率关系模型causal inference, lifting, probabilistic relational models

1 简介Introduction

人工智能研究领域的一个基本问题是智能体在关系域中理性地计划和行动。 为了计算感知状态下的最佳可能动作，代理会考虑可用的动作并选择具有最大预期效用的动作。 当计算对特定变量执行的操作的预期效用时，部署干预的语义而不是对该变量的典型条件至关重要A fundamental problem in the research field of artificial intelligence for an intelligent agent is to plan and act rationally in a relational domain. To compute the best possible action in a perceived state, the agent considers the available actions and chooses the one with the maximum expected utility. When computing the expected utility of an action performed on a specific variable, it is crucial to deploy the semantics of an intervention instead of a typical conditioning on that variable[Pearl2009a, Chapter 4]。 在计算干预效果时，特定变量被设置为固定值，并且对于特定查询，必须忽略该变量的所有传入概率因果影响。 部署干预的语义而不是典型的调节来正确确定行动的效果至关重要。 否则，当将行为视为证据时（通过应用经典条件反射），结论可能会产生误导。 例如，假设火灾的严重程度影响试图扑灭火灾的消防员的数量，即火灾越严重，值班的消防员就越多。 然后，经典条件反射建议减少消防员的数量，以降低火灾的严重程度（因为当值班的消防员数量较少时，发生严重火灾的可能性较低）。 在本文中，我们应用提升来有效计算关系域中的因果效应（从而计算动作的正确效果），其中高效推理是指在相对于域大小的多项式时间内运行的推理。. When calculating the effect of an intervention, a specific variable is set to a fixed value and all incoming probabilistic causal influences of this variable must be ignored for the specific query. It is fundamental to deploy the semantics of an intervention instead of the typical conditioning to correctly determine the effect of an action. Otherwise, when treating actions as evidence (by applying a classical conditioning), conclusions might become misleading. For example, assume a scenario in which the severity of fires influences the number of firefighters trying to extinguish the fire, that is, the more severe a fire is, the more firefighters are on duty. Classical conditioning then suggests to reduce the number of firefighters to reduce the severity of fires (because the probability for a severe fire is lower when observing a low number of firefighters on duty). In this article, we apply lifting to efficiently compute causal effects (and hence, the correct effect of actions) in relational domains, where efficient inference refers to inference running in polynomial time with respect to domain sizes.

在过去的几年里，因果模型已成为一种广泛使用的形式主义，用于回答有关干预对事物的因果影响的问题。Over the last years, causal models have become a widely used formalism to answer questions concerning the causal effect of an intervention on a随机变量random variable (兰德瓦尔randvar）在另一个) on another兰德瓦尔randvar。 因果模型包括. 本文基于并扩展了作品This article is based on and extends the works[Luttermann2024b]和and[Luttermann2024g]。 具体来说，我们在统一的视图下提出了所引入的提升因果推理的模型和算法，从而做出了以下贡献： 首先，我们给出一个正式的定义. Specifically, we present the introduced models and algorithms for lifted causal inference under a unified view, thereby making the following contributions: First, we give a formal definition of因果因素图causal factor graphs作为延伸as an extension ofFGFGs将因果知识纳入命题层面。 然后，我们提供了关于完全定向提升因果模型的统一视图to incorporate causal knowledge on a propositional level. We then provide a unified view on fully directed lifted causal models introduced byLuttermann2024b和部分定向提升因果模型引入and partially directed lifted causal models introduced byLuttermann2024g。 特别是，我们揭示了这些模型及其相应算法之间的联系，以在其中执行提升的因果推理。 我们特别强调了两个模型中所做假设的差异，并展示了这些假设如何影响其相应的推理算法。 此外，我们调整了模型定义和算法描述，以保持术语的一致性并提高清晰度。 我们还扩展了完全定向和部分定向提升因果模型的理论结果，并在完整的运行示例中展示了所有提出的概念。. In particular, we expose the connection between these models and their corresponding algorithms to perform lifted causal inference therein. We especially highlight the differences in the assumptions made in the two models and exhibit how these assumptions affect their corresponding inference algorithms. Furthermore, we align the model definitions and algorithm descriptions for consistency of terminology and improved clarity. We also extend the theoretical results for fully directed and partially directed lifted causal models and showcase all presented concepts on a full running example.

通过修改原始模型，进行介入查询By modifying the original model, an interventional queryP​(Q∣d​o​(R1′=r1′,…,Rk′=rk′))P(Q\mid do(R^{\prime}_{1}=r^{\prime}_{1},\allowbreak\ldots,\allowbreak R^{\prime}_{k}=r^{\prime}_{k}))可以通过计算结果来回答can be answered by computing the result of一个单一的a single修改后的模型中的概率查询（但是，模型的修改引入了一些开销）。 相反，直接在原始模型上使用截断的乘积公式，我们获得一组必须回答的多个概率查询。 在这两种情况下，都需要使用提升推理算法，例如probabilistic query in the modified model (however, the modification of the model introduces some overhead). Using the truncated product formula directly on the original model instead, we obtain a set of multiple probabilistic queries that have to be answered. In both cases, a lifted inference algorithm such as左心室容积LVE或or the力杰特LJT算法（如果需要回答一组概率查询作为截断乘积公式的结果，则该算法特别有利）可以用于在提升的级别上回答这些查询。algorithm (which is specifically advantageous if a set of probabilistic queries needs to be answered as a result of the truncated product formula) can be applied to answer these queries on a lifted level.

接下来我们展示如何在一个系统中有效地实现干预效果的计算We next show how the computation of the effect of interventions can efficiently be realised in aPD-PCFG。 一个重要的挑战是，干预的效果可能会根据不同因素之间的实际因果关系而有所不同。. An important challenge is that the effect of an intervention might differ depending on the actual causal relationships between the兰德瓦尔斯randvars。 由于可能有多种可能的因果解释，而我们不知道正确的解释，因此并不总是能够唯一地确定干预的效果。. As there might be multiple possible causal explanations and we do not know the correct one, it is not always possible to uniquely determine the effect of an intervention.

一般来说，可能存在这样的场景：即使存在连接到干预变量的无向边，也可以唯一地确定干预查询的结果，因为可能并非所有无向边都可以在两个方向上定向。 特别是，某些方向可能会引入循环或更改图结构隐含的条件独立语句，因此不会导致一致的扩展。 换句话说，干预变量的父项可能只有一个可能的方向，在这种情况下，任何干预查询的结果都可以唯一确定。Generally, there might be scenarios in which it is possible to uniquely determine the result of an interventional query even if there are undirected edges connected to the intervention variables, as possibly not all undirected edges can be oriented in both directions. In particular, some orientations might introduce a cycle or change the conditional independence statements implied by the graph structure and hence do not result in a consistent extension. In other words, it might be possible that there is just a single possible orientation of the parents of the intervention variables and in this case, the result of any interventional query can be uniquely determined.

7 结论Conclusion

我们介绍We introducePCFGPCFGs将提升的概率推理与因果知识相结合。 为了利用提升推理的力量来计算干预措施的效果，我们进一步提出了to combine lifted probabilistic inference with causal knowledge. To leverage the power of lifted inference for the computation of the effect of interventions, we further present the生命周期指数LCI算法，它在提升的水平上运行，因此与在等效命题（基础）模型上运行因果推理相比，它使我们能够大大加快因果推理速度。algorithm, which operates on a lifted level and thus allows us to drastically speed up causal inference compared to running causal inference on an equivalent propositional (ground) model.\AcLCI 是一种简单而有效的算法，用于计算干预措施的效果。 此外，我们还介绍lci is a simple, yet effective algorithm to compute the effect of interventions. Moreover, we introducePD-PCFGPD-PCFGs作为提升因果模型，允许合并部分因果知识，从而实现提升因果推理，而不需要手头有完全指定的因果图。 一个as lifted causal models that allow to incorporate partial causal knowledge, thereby enabling lifted causal inference without the requirement of having a fully specified causal graph at hand. APD-PCFG概括了一个概念generalises the concept of aPCFG通过在图结构中合并无向边和有向边。 计算干预措施的效果by incorporating both undirected and directed edges in the graph structure. To compute the effect of interventions in aPD-PCFG，我们介绍, we introduce theELCI算法，它枚举了介入查询的所有可能结果，而不为整个模型奠定基础。algorithm, which enumerates all possible results for an interventional query without grounding the entire model.

未来工作的一个有趣的方向是放宽因果充分性假设（An interesting direction for future work is to relax the causal sufficiency assumption (Def.˜5）并允许隐藏的混杂因素（即未观察到的混杂变量，因此未包含在一组混杂变量中）) and allow for hidden confounders (i.e., confounding variables that are not observed and hence not included in the set of兰德瓦尔斯randvars模型是在其上定义的）over which the model is defined) in aPD-PCFG。 在存在隐藏的混杂因素的情况下，干预查询的结果可能不再是唯一可确定的。 因此，如果存在隐藏的混杂因素，识别问题（即确定是否可以唯一识别因果效应的问题）就变得相关。 特别是，一个有趣的问题是，是否. Under the presence of hidden confounders, the result of an interventional query might not be uniquely determinable anymore. Thus, the identification problem (i.e., the problem of determining whether a causal effect can be uniquely identified) becomes relevant if hidden confounders are present.
